      "source": [
        "# Project 5: Spam Detection Using Naive Bayes + TF-IDF\n",
        "\n",
        "# step 1: importing the libraries\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer\n",
        "from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report, confusion_matrix"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 2,
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "pwKc8eoE5CgF",
        "outputId": "1bf6838b-2509-4c4a-fc7a-ca6a18cdddbd"
      },
      "outputs": [
        {
          "name": "stdout",
          "output_type": "stream",
          "text": [
            "  label                                            message\n",
            "0   ham         Hey! Are we still meeting for lunch today?\n",
            "1   ham                               I'll call you later.\n",
            "2  spam  Congratulations! You've won a $500 gift card. ...\n",
            "3  spam  URGENT! Your account has been suspended. Click...\n",
            "4   ham      Don't forget to bring the documents tomorrow.\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "# step 2: load the dataset using github\n",
        "\n",
        "url = \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/programmer-sahil/Ardent_ML_Training/main/Project%205/spam_dataset.csv\"\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(url)\n",
        "print(df.head())"
      ]
    },
    {

      "execution_count": 3,
      "metadata": {

      ],
      "source": [
        "# step 3: Encode labels\n",
        "\n",
        "df['label_encoded'] = df['label'].map({'ham': 0, 'spam': 1})\n",
        "print(df.head)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Why? ML algorithms need numbers, not words\n"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 4,
      "metadata": {
        "id": "Gw6hta2Z71xM"
      },
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "# step 4: Train / Test Split\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "    df['message'],\n",
        "    df['label_encoded'],\n",
        "    test_size=0.2,\n",
        "    random_state=42\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "'''\n",
        "train → learning\n",
        "\n",
        "test → evaluation\n",
        "\n",
        "20% test gives good balance\n",
        "'''"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 7,
      "metadata": {
        "id": "qwWCsU048nnI"
      },
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "#step 5: TF-IDF Vectorization\n",
        "\n",
        "tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(stop_words='english')\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train)\n",
        "X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "# TF-IDF converts text to numbers by weighting important words like:\n",
        "# \"FREE\", \"OFFER\", \"WIN\", \"PRIZE\""
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 8,
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 35
        },
        "id": "fWSzKkp09Jii",
        "outputId": "faaaefae-e4af-4c51-b713-88927b7eb7ea"
      },
      "outputs": [
        {
          "data": {
            "application/vnd.google.colaboratory.intrinsic+json": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "text/plain": [
              "'\\nWhy Naive Bayes?\\nVery fast, Works great for text, low memory usuage\\n'"
            ]
          },
          "execution_count": 8,
          "metadata": {},
          "output_type": "execute_result"
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "# step 6: Train Naive Bayes Model\n",
        "\n",
        "model = MultinomialNB()\n",
        "model.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "'''\n",
        "Why Naive Bayes?\n",
        "Very fast, Works great for text, low memory usuage\n",
        "'''"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 9,
      "metadata": {
        "id": "hGstPHnX9cKx"
      },
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "# step 7: Make Predictions\n",
        "\n",
        "y_pred = model.predict(X_test_tfidf)"
      ]
    },

      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 11,

            ]
          },
          "execution_count": 11,
          "metadata": {},
          "output_type": "execute_result"
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "# step 8: Evaluate Model\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Accuracy:\", accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred))\n",
        "print(\"\\nClassification Report:\\n\", classification_report(y_test, y_pred, target_names=['ham', 'spam']))\n",
        "print(\"\\n Confusion Matrix:\\n\", confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred))\n",
        "\n",
        "'''\n",
        "Accuracy: overall correctness\n",
        "Precision: quality of spam predictions\n",
        "Recall: how many spam messages were caught\n",
        "Confusion Matrix: breakdown of TP, TN, FP, FN\n",
        "'''"
      ]
    },

        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.35);\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.85);\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-actions {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  flex-wrap: wrap;\n",
        "  gap: 0.9rem;\n",
        "  margin-bottom: 1.4rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".btn-primary {\n",
        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  padding: 0.6rem 1.35rem;\n",
        "  border: none;\n",
        "  cursor: pointer;\n",
        "  background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, #f97316, #a855f7);\n",
        "  color: #f9fafb;\n",
        "  font-size: 0.9rem;\n",
        "  font-weight: 500;\n",
        "  display: inline-flex;\n",
        "  align-items: center;\n",
        "  gap: 0.35rem;\n",
        "  box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(15,23,42,0.8);\n",
        "  transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition), filter var(--transition);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".btn-primary:hover {\n",
        "  transform: translateY(-1px);\n",
        "  filter: brightness(1.05);\n",
        "  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(15,23,42,0.9);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".btn-ghost {\n",
        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem;\n",
        "  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.85);\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "  font-size: 0.9rem;\n",
        "  display: inline-flex;\n",
        "  align-items: center;\n",
        "  gap: 0.35rem;\n",
        "  cursor: pointer;\n",
        "  transition: background var(--transition), border-color var(--transition), color var(--transition), transform var(--transition);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".btn-ghost:hover {\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.95);\n",
        "  border-color: var(--accent);\n",
        "  color: #e5e7eb;\n",
        "  transform: translateY(-1px);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-meta {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  align-items: center;\n",
        "  gap: 0.8rem;\n",
        "  font-size: 0.78rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-meta-item {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  align-items: center;\n",
        "  gap: 0.35rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-meta-dot {\n",
        "  width: 7px;\n",
        "  height: 7px;\n",
        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  background: #22c55e;\n",
        "  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(34,197,94,0.6);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "/* Hero Right Card */\n",
        ".hero-right {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  align-items: center;\n",
        "  justify-content: center;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-card {\n",
        "  width: 100%;\n",
        "  max-width: 340px;\n",
        "  aspect-ratio: 3/4;\n",
        "  border-radius: 1.5rem;\n",
        "  border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.35);\n",
        "  background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(148,163,184,0.2), rgba(15,23,42,0.95));\n",
        "  box-shadow: 0 25px 50px rgba(15,23,42,0.9);\n",
        "  padding: 1.1rem;\n",
        "  position: relative;\n",
        "  overflow: hidden;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-card::before {\n",
        "  content: \"\";\n",
        "  position: absolute;\n",
        "  inset: -30%;\n",
        "  background: radial-gradient(circle at 0 0, rgba(244,114,182,0.28), transparent 55%);\n",
        "  opacity: 0.9;\n",
        "  mix-blend-mode: screen;\n",
        "  animation: floatGlow 10s ease-in-out infinite alternate;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "@keyframes floatGlow {\n",
        "  0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }\n",
        "  100% { transform: translate(18px, 8px); }\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-card-inner {\n",
        "  position: relative;\n",
        "  z-index: 1;\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  flex-direction: column;\n",
        "  height: 100%;\n",
        "  justify-content: space-between;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-avatar {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  align-items: center;\n",
        "  gap: 0.7rem;\n",
        "  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-avatar-circle {\n",
        "  width: 46px;\n",
        "  height: 46px;\n",
        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  border: 2px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.8);\n",
        "  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #fbbf24, #020617);\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  align-items: center;\n",
        "  justify-content: center;\n",
        "  font-weight: 700;\n",
        "  color: #0f172a;\n",
        "  font-size: 1rem;\n",
        "  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(250,204,21,0.5);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-avatar-text span:first-child {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.85rem;\n",
        "  font-weight: 500;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-avatar-text span:last-child {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.7rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".chip-row {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  flex-wrap: wrap;\n",
        "  gap: 0.35rem;\n",
        "  margin: 0.4rem 0 0.6rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".chip {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.68rem;\n",
        "  padding: 0.15rem 0.6rem;\n",
        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9);\n",
        "  border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.35);\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-card-stats {\n",
        "  display: grid;\n",
        "  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);\n",
        "  gap: 0.4rem;\n",
        "  margin-top: 0.4rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".stat-card {\n",
        "  border-radius: 0.8rem;\n",
        "  border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.35);\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.92);\n",
        "  padding: 0.45rem 0.4rem;\n",
        "  text-align: left;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".stat-card span:first-child {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.7rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".stat-card span:last-child {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.9rem;\n",
        "  font-weight: 600;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".hero-card-footer {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.72rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "  border-top: 1px dashed rgba(148,163,184,0.5);\n",
        "  padding-top: 0.5rem;\n",
        "  margin-top: 0.6rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "/* Sections */\n",
        "section {\n",
        "  padding: 1.8rem 0;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".section-header {\n",
        "  margin-bottom: 1rem;\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  flex-direction: column;\n",
        "  gap: 0.1rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".section-kicker {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.75rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--accent-2);\n",
        "  text-transform: uppercase;\n",
        "  letter-spacing: 0.08em;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".section-title {\n",
        "  font-size: 1.25rem;\n",
        "  font-weight: 600;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".section-subtitle {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.85rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "  max-width: 34rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "/* About */\n",
        ".about-grid {\n",
        "  display: grid;\n",
        "  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 1fr);\n",
        "  gap: 1.4rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".about-text {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.86rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "  line-height: 1.6;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".about-card {\n",
        "  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);\n",
        "  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);\n",
        "  background: var(--glass);\n",
        "  padding: 1rem;\n",
        "  font-size: 0.8rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".about-list {\n",
        "  margin-top: 0.6rem;\n",
        "  display: grid;\n",
        "  gap: 0.4rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".about-item {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  align-items: flex-start;\n",
        "  gap: 0.4rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".about-item-bullet {\n",
        "  width: 8px;\n",
        "  height: 8px;\n",
        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  background: var(--accent);\n",
        "  margin-top: 0.18rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "/* Skills */\n",
        ".skills-grid {\n",
        "  display: grid;\n",
        "  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));\n",
        "  gap: 0.7rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".skill-card {\n",
        "  border-radius: 0.9rem;\n",
        "  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9);\n",
        "  padding: 0.8rem;\n",
        "  font-size: 0.8rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".skill-title {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.88rem;\n",
        "  font-weight: 500;\n",
        "  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".skill-tags {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  flex-wrap: wrap;\n",
        "  gap: 0.25rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".skill-tag {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.7rem;\n",
        "  padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem;\n",
        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9);\n",
        "  border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.4);\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "/* Projects */\n",
        ".projects-grid {\n",
        "  display: grid;\n",
        "  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));\n",
        "  gap: 1rem;\n",
        "  margin-top: 0.5rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-card {\n",
        "  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);\n",
        "  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9);\n",
        "  padding: 0.9rem;\n",
        "  position: relative;\n",
        "  overflow: hidden;\n",
        "  transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition), border-color var(--transition), background var(--transition);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-card::before {\n",
        "  content: \"\";\n",
        "  position: absolute;\n",
        "  inset: -40%;\n",
        "  background: conic-gradient(\n",
        "    from 180deg,\n",
        "    rgba(124,58,237,0.2),\n",
        "    rgba(34,197,94,0.2),\n",
        "    transparent 65%\n",
        "  );\n",
        "  opacity: 0;\n",
        "  transition: opacity 0.4s ease;\n",
        "  z-index: -1;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-card:hover::before {\n",
        "  opacity: 1;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-card:hover {\n",
        "  transform: translateY(-4px);\n",
        "  box-shadow: 0 22px 45px rgba(15,23,42,0.9);\n",
        "  border-color: rgba(129,140,248,0.7);\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.97);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-pill {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.7rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--accent-2);\n",
        "  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-title {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.95rem;\n",
        "  font-weight: 500;\n",
        "  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-desc {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.8rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-meta {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  flex-wrap: wrap;\n",
        "  justify-content: space-between;\n",
        "  align-items: center;\n",
        "  gap: 0.4rem;\n",
        "  font-size: 0.74rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-tech {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  flex-wrap: wrap;\n",
        "  gap: 0.25rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-tech span {\n",
        "  padding: 0.12rem 0.5rem;\n",
        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9);\n",
        "  border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.5);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-links a {\n",
        "  color: var(--accent);\n",
        "  text-decoration: none;\n",
        "  font-size: 0.76rem;\n",
        "  display: inline-flex;\n",
        "  align-items: center;\n",
        "  gap: 0.2rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".project-links a:hover {\n",
        "  text-decoration: underline;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "/* Timeline */\n",
        ".timeline {\n",
        "  border-left: 1px dashed rgba(148,163,184,0.6);\n",
        "  padding-left: 0.8rem;\n",
        "  margin-top: 0.4rem;\n",
        "  display: grid;\n",
        "  gap: 0.65rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".timeline-item {\n",
        "  position: relative;\n",
        "  padding-left: 0.6rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".timeline-dot {\n",
        "  position: absolute;\n",
        "  left: -0.92rem;\n",
        "  top: 0.25rem;\n",
        "  width: 9px;\n",
        "  height: 9px;\n",
        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  background: var(--accent-2);\n",
        "  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(34,197,94,0.7);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".timeline-title {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.85rem;\n",
        "  font-weight: 500;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".timeline-meta {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.75rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "  margin-bottom: 0.15rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".timeline-text {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.8rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "/* Contact & Footer */\n",
        ".contact-grid {\n",
        "  display: grid;\n",
        "  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 1fr);\n",
        "  gap: 1.3rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".contact-card {\n",
        "  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);\n",
        "  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.92);\n",
        "  padding: 1rem;\n",
        "  font-size: 0.8rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".contact-row {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  flex-wrap: wrap;\n",
        "  gap: 0.6rem;\n",
        "  margin-top: 0.5rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".contact-item {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.78rem;\n",
        "  padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem;\n",
        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.5);\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".social-row {\n",
        "  display: flex;\n",
        "  flex-wrap: wrap;\n",
        "  gap: 0.6rem;\n",
        "  margin-top: 0.5rem;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".social-row a {\n",
        "  font-size: 0.8rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "  text-decoration: none;\n",
        "  padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem;\n",
        "  border-radius: 999px;\n",
        "  border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.5);\n",
        "  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9);\n",
        "  transition: background var(--transition), color var(--transition), border-color var(--transition);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".social-row a:hover {\n",
        "  background: rgba(30,64,175,0.9);\n",
        "  color: #e5e7eb;\n",
        "  border-color: rgba(191,219,254,0.9);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "footer {\n",
        "  padding: 1rem 0 1.4rem;\n",
        "  font-size: 0.75rem;\n",
        "  color: var(--muted);\n",
        "  text-align: center;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "/* Scroll reveal */\n",
        ".reveal {\n",
        "  opacity: 0;\n",
        "  transform: translateY(15px);\n",
        "  transition: opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.7s ease;\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        ".reveal.visible {\n",
        "  opacity: 1;\n",
        "  transform: translateY(0);\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "/* Responsive */\n",
        "@media (max-width: 900px) {\n",
        "  .hero,\n",
        "  .about-grid,\n",
        "  .contact-grid {\n",
        "    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);\n",
        "  }\n",
        "\n",
        "  .hero {\n",
        "    padding-top: 1.8rem;\n",
        "  }\n",
        "\n",
        "  .hero-right {\n",
        "    order: -1;\n",
        "  }\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "@media (max-width: 720px) {\n",
        "  nav ul {\n",
        "    position: fixed;\n",
        "    inset: 3.2rem 1rem auto 1rem;\n",
        "    border-radius: 0.9rem;\n",
        "    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);\n",
        "    background: rgba(15,23,42,0.98);\n",
        "    padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;\n",
        "    flex-direction: column;\n",
        "    gap: 0.6rem;\n",
        "    transform: translateY(-30px);\n",
        "    opacity: 0;\n",
        "    pointer-events: none;\n",
        "    transition: opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease;\n",
        "  }\n",
        "\n",
        "  nav ul.open {\n",
        "    opacity: 1;\n",
        "    transform: translateY(0);\n",
        "    pointer-events: auto;\n",
        "  }\n",
        "\n",
        "  .nav-toggle {\n",
        "    display: inline-flex;\n",
        "  }\n",
        "\n",
        "  .hero-actions {\n",
        "    flex-direction: column;\n",
        "    align-items: flex-start;\n",
        "  }\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "@media (max-width: 480px) {\n",
        "  .hero h1 {\n",
        "    font-size: 1.65rem;\n",
        "  }\n",
        "  .hero-card {\n",
        "    max-width: 100%;\n",
        "  }\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "  </style>\n",
        "</head>\n",
        "\n",
        "<body>\n",
        "  <!-- VIDEO BACKGROUND -->\n",
        "  <video class=\"video-bg\" autoplay muted loop playsinline>\n",
        "    <source src=\"https://player.vimeo.com/external/3129576.sd.mp4?s=4d44c46cf649ae51d815eb147c2e1fa89bbf9081&profile_id=164&oauth2_token_id=57447761\" type=\"video/mp4\">\n",
        "  </video>\n",
        "  <div class=\"video-overlay\"></div>\n",
        "  <div class=\"page-overlay\"></div>\n",
        "\n",
        "  <!-- HEADER / NAV -->\n",
        "  <header>\n",
        "    <div class=\"container\">\n",
        "      <div class=\"nav\">\n",
        "        <div class=\"brand\">\n",
        "          <div class=\"brand-logo\">CS</div>\n",
        "          <div class=\"brand-text\">\n",
        "            <span>CSE 8th Semester</span>\n",
        "            <span>Swami Vivekananda Institute of Science &amp; Technology</span>\n",
        "          </div>\n",
        "        </div>\n",
        "\n",
        "        <button class=\"nav-toggle\" id=\"navToggle\">\n",
        "          <span></span>\n",
        "        </button>\n",
        "\n",
        "        <nav>\n",
        "          <ul id=\"navMenu\">\n",
        "            <li><a href=\"#hero\" class=\"active\">Home</a></li>\n",
        "            <li><a href=\"#about\">About</a></li>\n",
        "            <li><a href=\"#skills\">Skills</a></li>\n",
        "            <li><a href=\"#projects\">Projects</a></li>\n",
        "            <li><a href=\"#journey\">Journey</a></li>\n",
        "            <li><a href=\"#contact\">Contact</a></li>\n",
        "          </ul>\n",
        "        </nav>\n",
        "      </div>\n",
        "    </div>\n",
        "  </header>\n",
        "\n",
        "  <!-- HERO -->\n",
        "  <main>\n",
        "    <section id=\"hero\" class=\"hero container\">\n",
        "      <div class=\"hero-left reveal\">\n",

        "            <a href=\"https://github.com/sujan011\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">💻 GitHub</a>\n",
        "            <a href=\"https://www.linkedin.com/in/sujan-sardar-5b7bba253/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">🔗 LinkedIn</a>\n",
        "            <a href=\"https://www.kaggle.com\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">📊 Kaggle</a>\n",
        "            <a href=\"#hero\">⬇ Download CV</a>\n",
        "          </div>\n",
        "        </div>\n",
        "      </div>\n",
        "    </section>\n",
        "  </main>\n",
        "\n",
        "  <!-- FOOTER -->\n",
        "  <footer>\n",
        "    <div class=\"container\">\n",
        "      <p>\n",
        "        © <span id=\"year\"></span> CSE 8th Semester · Swami Vivekananda Institute of Science &amp; Technology, Kolkata.\n",
        "        Built with HTML, CSS and a lot of curiosity for Machine Learning.\n",
        "      </p>\n",
        "    </div>\n",
        "  </footer>\n",
        "\n",
        "  <!-- SCRIPTS -->\n",
        "  <script>\n",
        "    // Mobile nav toggle\n",
        "    const navToggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');\n",
        "    const navMenu = document.getElementById('navMenu');\n",
        "\n",
        "    navToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {\n",
        "      navToggle.classList.toggle('active');\n",
        "      navMenu.classList.toggle('open');\n",
        "    });\n",
        "\n",
        "    // Close mobile menu on link click\n",
        "    navMenu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {\n",
        "      link.addEventListener('click', () => {\n",
        "        navToggle.classList.remove('active');\n",
        "        navMenu.classList.remove('open');\n",
        "      });\n",
        "    });\n",
        "\n",
        "    // Scroll reveal animation\n",
        "    const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');\n",
        "\n",
        "    function handleScrollReveal() {\n",
        "      const triggerBottom = window.innerHeight * 0.88;\n",
        "\n",
        "      revealElements.forEach(el => {\n",
        "        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n",
        "        if (rect.top < triggerBottom) {\n",
        "          el.classList.add('visible');\n",
        "        }\n",
        "      });\n",
        "    }\n",
        "\n",
        "    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScrollReveal);\n",
        "    window.addEventListener('load', handleScrollReveal);\n",
        "\n",
        "    // Active nav link on scroll\n",
        "    const sections = document.querySelectorAll('main section[id]');\n",
        "    const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('nav a');\n",
        "\n",
        "    function setActiveNav() {\n",
        "      let currentId = '';\n",
        "\n",
        "      sections.forEach(sec => {\n",
        "        const rect = sec.getBoundingClientRect();\n",
        "        if (rect.top <= 80 && rect.bottom > 80) {\n",
        "          currentId = sec.id;\n",
        "        }\n",
        "      });\n",
        "\n",
        "      navLinks.forEach(link => {\n",
        "        link.classList.toggle('active', link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + currentId);\n",
        "      });\n",
        "    }\n",
        "\n",
        "    window.addEventListener('scroll', setActiveNav);\n",
        "\n",
        "    // Dynamic year in footer\n",
        "    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();\n",
        "  </script>\n",
        "</body>\n",
        "</html>"
      ]
    }
  ],
